description: Remove a reaction: the bot's own by default, or another user's (which needs Manage Messages).

emoji.description: The reaction to remove. A standard emoji (the character itself), or one of this server's custom emoji by name, like party or :party:, or as <:party:ID>.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

message_id.description: Message ID, or the message's link.

user.description: Whose reaction to remove; omit for the bot's own.

name: remove_reaction
title: Remove reaction
